Small playback presets used for field checks on residential audio units.
The repository keeps the preset index alongside notes used by the service team.

| Code | Media ID | Purpose |

| H-12 | QN-02 | door chime level check |
| H-17 | YD-04 | overnight room check |

- Presets are shared across the field kit and home-unit test accounts.
- The code is used as a short label in service notes; the scheduler catalog holds the playback item.
